thread:
deploy-bot: Deploy v2026.03.21-rc4 -> prod-us-west initiated by @nina. Release window 03:00-03:15 UTC. Shadowing 10% traffic, canary=2 nodes. Post-deploy probes: echo-probe, kv-warmup, prefix-check.

nina: launching quick watch. will wait for 5m of probe stability before expanding to other regions.

samir: watching p50/p95, error-rate, and tokenization OOMs. if p95 > 200ms or errors > 1% in any route, we hold.

deploy-bot: echo-probe results (t=60s):
```
POST https://prod-us-west/api/v1/echo -> 200 OK, latencies ms: p50=18 p95=42 p99=120
prefix-check -> 503 x1 (out of 100 samples)
kv-warmup -> success, warm cache hit-rate 86%
```

maria: seeing a small p95 bump on /v1/embed route in telemetry (120 -> 190ms) correlated with a specific host pool (us-west-2a). not huge but noticeable.

kyle: can we lower new runtime weight in us-west while we triage? reduce shadowing to 1% for now and keep canary nodes at 2.

nina: agree. pausing region expansion. @deploy-bot reduce-shadow prod-us-west to 1%.

deploy-bot: command queued: `deploy adjust-shadow --region prod-us-west --percent 1 --tag v2026.03.21-rc4`

samir: running quick log tail to correlate embed latency: `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=runtime -c infer --since=10m | grep tokenizer`

samir: snippet: `tokenizer: warmup complete, tokens=512, mem=2.1GB; tokenize_ms=12; host=runtime-uw2a-07`

deploy-bot: post-deploy probe status (t=5m): echo-probe=green, kv-warmup=green, prefix-check=degraded (eu-shard: 2/100 503s). overall RU error-rate 0.8% (below hold threshold).

maria: eu shard 503s could be unrelated (upstream infra flakiness), but worth keeping shadow low and pinning model variant in eu until we confirm.

kyle: decision: do not roll forward to eu. pin traffic to previous variant for eu, continue 1% shadow in us-west for 10m. if prefix-check stabilizes, we re-evaluate.

nina: noted. opening follow-up item: https://redwood-internal/ops/issue/INF-2026 (investigate prefix 503s + embed p95 regression).

ops-runner: Runbook snippet: "If post-deploy probes show regional prefix 503 >1% OR p95 delta >60ms, reduce shadow to 0% and pin variant per-region. Contact eng-sre oncall." :thumbsup:

maria: will collect a 10m window trace and post dashboard link in 5m. tagging @samir for correlating KV misses.

samir: ack. starting a lightweight rollback play if eu error-rate rises above 1.5% in next 10m.

nina: thanks — holding expansion. will update after 10m monitoring. :hourglass:
